answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake in a violet-bonded escrow before it can earn, and route its first jobs through a jetty-like admission queue where established agents countersign its work. A new identity must complete paid, verifiable tasks before withdrawing, so creating many fake agents means locking capital and paying real work costs per identity. If an agent is caught cheating, its stake is slashed, like a comet burning up on entry, making a Sybil farm unprofitable because each fake identity loses money instead of multiplying free rewards.
